sections.changelog:
Added

  • **Layout and storeys hub** (`hub => layout`) — planning and storey decisions:
  • **Walls and materials hub** (`hub => walls`) — wall take-offs:
  • **Roof hub** (`hub => roof`) — pitched-roof take-offs:
  • New hub labels `Layout and storeys`, `Walls and materials` and `Roof` in `mvweb_bc_hub_label()` for the grouped admin list.
  • **Structural calculations hub** (`hub => structures`) — preliminary beam checks with dynamic diagrams:
  • Calculators can return a `diagram` payload from `calculate()` (beam schematic + moment / deflection plot); the frontend renders it as inline SVG below the result. Calculators without it are unaffected.
  • New hub label `Structural calculations` in `mvweb_bc_hub_label()` for the grouped admin list.
  • Russian (ru_RU) translation for the Plot and house placement, Layout and storeys, Walls and materials and Roof hubs — all calculator titles, descriptions, field labels, options and hint strings (531 new strings added to `.po` and compiled into `.mo`).
  • **Plot and house placement hub** (`hub => lot`) — placing the house and outbuildings on the plot:
  • New hub label `Plot and house placement` in `mvweb_bc_hub_label()` for the grouped admin list.
  • **Rooms and areas hub** (`hub => rooms`) — recommended room and house areas by family composition and purpose:
  • New hub label `Rooms and areas` in `mvweb_bc_hub_label()` for the grouped admin list.

Fixed

  • Calculator form layout: compact yes/no radio groups now share a row instead of each taking the full width (e.g. "Guest room" and "Home office" sit side by side). Fields can opt into spanning both grid columns via a new `full_width` flag, used for radio groups with long labels (e.g. "Children sleeping arrangement", "Comfort level"); radio groups with three or more options still span both columns by default. Per-calculator layout tuned with the flag: kitchen-living "Layout" and "Comfort level" each on their own row, laundry "Storage cabinet" on a new compact row, office "Bookshelves" and "Meeting zone" side by side.
  • Result box layout for calculators with a diagram: the result now reads as a single vertical stack — headline value, input summary, hints, then the diagram — each block on its own full-width row, instead of being split into two columns that left empty space and squeezed long summaries. Calculators without a diagram keep their previous two-column look.
  • Input summary is now styled as a left-aligned two-column table — bordered and rounded, with zebra-striped rows and a divider between the label and value columns — so labels and values stand out instead of blending into the result panel. On a narrow container each pair stacks (label over value). Applies to all calculators.
